facts.sentence: On Friday, Oct 30, 1,677 of the 1,778 elevators AGSIST reads posted a lower cash corn bid than Thursday, 84 a higher one; 160 changed their basis, 39 weaker and 121 stronger.

facts.unit: cents per bushel, median change in cash bid
facts.source: AGSIST elevator network, last posted bid per trading day (data/bids-prev)
facts.comparison: last posted bid on 2026-10-30 vs 2026-10-29, same board, crop and delivery period
